summary: Adds the planned reviewed write catalog.archive (action catalog_archive): archive 1–20 selling units or variants of one Product. Review names each target, refuses already archived, foreign or still-reserved targets with reasons, says what stays for sale (or that the Product stops appearing for sale), and binds a digest over offering/variant state and reservations. Executes through the canonical archive commands (variant archive gained a transaction seam). Receipt opens the exact Product on both clients; dashboard and native editors let the user drop targets and change the reason. Larger or cross-Product batches and deletion stay on the forms.
